import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime format
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Group by date and sum the total sales
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='b', label='Total Sales')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.title('Daily Total Coffee Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend()

# Save the figure

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime format
df['date'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date'])

# Group by date and sum the total sales
daily_sales = df.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Plotting
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='b', label='Total Sales')

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Date')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)')
plt.title('Daily Total Coffee Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.legend()

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
